summary.text: Mark Walker has represented the 27th District in the Illinois Senate since 2024; Walker previously served in the Illinois House from 2009 to 2011 and from 2019 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography describes Walker as a Vietnam veteran and a former financial industry executive, entrepreneur and management consultant.
Walker earned a B.A. and an M.A. from Brown University.
